name: Ibraheem Shakir H
testimony:
You made me realize that I shouldn’t wait for the perfect opportunity in my career and that I should move forward with what I have in front of me right now.

I’m currently working at an MNC. Although it’s not related to what I originally wanted to pursue as a career, I don’t have to stress anymore about what I should do next. I have a stable income, and I can always try to switch to another job. Even if things don’t go as planned, I still have my current job to fall back on.

Your sessions really made me think this way. If I had never attended your classes, I would probably still be doing nothing and wasting my time on something that wouldn’t benefit me in the future.

Thank you, Vishal bro, for guiding me throughout my career journey. I’m truly grateful for your guidance and support.

name: Pranav Adith S
testimony:
Honestly, I don’t think calling you just “sir” is enough. For me, you’ve always been more like an elder brother and a friend than a teacher.

When I think about my placement journey, you are definitely one of the main reasons I reached where I am today. When I started, I had very little confidence, especially when it came to English, communication and facing interviews. You literally helped me build everything from zero.

What I liked the most was that your classes never felt like normal classes. It always felt like we were sitting with friends, talking, having fun, making mistakes, and learning at the same time. That comfort made it so much easier for me to improve.

From helping me with English and communication to guiding me through placement preparation and interviews, you were always there. I genuinely feel that the person I was when I started and the person I am now are completely different.

And honestly, getting placed at Accenture is a big achievement for me, but I know that a big part of that journey was possible because of you. You didn’t just prepare me for a placement — you helped me gain confidence in myself.

You literally took me from zero to hero. 😂❤️

I’ll always be grateful for that. No matter where I go in my career, I’ll always remember you as the person who helped me take that first big step.

Thank you for everything, Vishal ettaa ❤️
